operatoren.definition: give an opinion or suggestion to your partner about what should be done in a particular situation
beispiele: • Advise your partner on whether s/he should apply for the internship s/he has presented to you.

operatoren.definition: come to one opinion or an understanding; arrive at a settlement
beispiele: • Agree on two strategies to encourage more young people to get involved. • Come to an agreement on what to be included in your presentation.

operatoren.definition: describe and explain in detail by referring to relevant means
beispiele: • For a youth conference on American ideals, visions and traditions, you have been asked to give an oral presentation about the cartoon. Analyze the cartoon. • You are preparing a photo exhibition for an international youth convention on the topic City Environments. Analyze the photographs.

operatoren.definition: make a case based on appropriate evidence for and/or against some given point of view
beispiele: • In a discussion about the replacement of textbooks by portable computers at school argue for or against this proposal.

operatoren.definition: express a well-founded opinion on the nature or quality of sb./sth.
beispiele: • Assess ecological, economic and social aspects of the extraction of fossil fuels. • Evaluate the chances for an applicant’s personal development described in the job offer at hand.

operatoren.definition: state one’s opinion clearly and support one’s view with evidence or reasons
beispiele: • As members of your school’s student council you and your partner are expected to organize a panel discussion on the importance of moral issues in today’s society. Comment on the following statistics. • The media scouts at your school are organizing a panel discussion for an international youth convention. You have found some material. Comment on the material.

operatoren.definition: show similarities and differences
beispiele: • You are preparing a photo exhibition for an international youth convention on the topic “City Environments”. Compare the aspects of city life shown in the photographs. • Based on the charts, compare the job situation of young people your age in Germany and the UK.

operatoren.definition: give a detailed account of what sth. / sb. is like
beispiele: • You and your partner are participating in an international youth convention on environmental challenges. You are looking for photographs to illustrate your presentation. Describe the pictures to your partner.

operatoren.definition: examine the different sides of an issue and come to a conclusion – or give the partner(s) the opportunity to come to a conclusion
beispiele: • You and your partner are participating in a youth convention about robotics. Together with your partner discuss the benefits and challenges of further scientific innovations.

operatoren.definition: make sth. clear
beispiele: • Explain the message of the cartoon and the means used to convey it.

operatoren.definition: explain the meaning/message/purpose of sth.
beispiele: • Interpret the data on the development of volunteerism among young people in the last 20 years.

operatoren.definition: put forward sth. for consideration
beispiele: • Study the diagrams on demographic development in Europe and present possible conclusions for your country. • Present possible strategies to reduce the use of plastics.

operatoren.definition: express one’s thoughts in a profound and personal way
beispiele: • For your presentation on social sustainability, reflect on further aspects of the topic to be included.

operatoren.definition: give a concise account of the main points or ideas of a text, issue or topic
beispiele: • Summarize the strengths and weaknesses of the various research methods presented in the text.
